{k : Type u_1} →
  [inst : Field.{u_1} k] →
    (n : Nat) →
      {Y : Type u_2} →
        [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} Y] →
          [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k Y] →
            [Module.Finite.{u_1, u_2} k Y] →
              Representation.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k) Y → Prop

∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] (n : Nat) {Y : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} Y]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} k Y] [inst_3 : Module.Finite.{u_1, u_2} k Y]
  (ρ : Representation.{u_1, u_1, u_2} k (Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.{0, u_1} (Fin n) k) Y),
  Iff (Etingof.IsAlgebraicRepresentation.{u_1, u_2} n ρ)
    (Etingof.IsAlgebraicCoefficientFamily.{u_1, u_2} n fun g =>
      DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
